name: libro-uz
description: Root dev orchestration for Libro.UZ (Django + Vite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n django,vite -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:django" "npm run dev:vite"
scripts.test:e2e:prepare: cross-env E2E_RELAX_THROTTLE=1 DEBUG=True python backend/manage.py migrate --noinput && cross-env E2E_RELAX_THROTTLE=1 DEBUG=True python backend/manage.py seed_e2e
